auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Welcome back. Sign in with the email or username your school gave you.
auth.helpText: Trouble signing in? Your school office can reset your account.

dashboard.noCurrentYearHelp: Add the school year and mark it as current to see term progress here.
dashboard.noTermToday: No term is in session today.
dashboard.noUpcoming: Nothing on the calendar for the next 60 days.
dashboard.memberIntro: Your school is setting things up. Sections in the menu open as soon as they are ready.

account.title: Your account
account.changePasswordIntro: Other devices signed in to your account will be signed out. This one stays signed in.
account.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
account.passwordTooShort: The new password needs at least {{min}} characters.
account.forcedIntro: Hi {{name}}, you signed in with a temporary password from the school. Choose your own password to continue.
account.languageHelp: Used on this device. Your school administrator can change your default.

reset.requestIntro: Enter the email address you use to sign in. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
reset.requestSent: If an account uses this address, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.
reset.noEmailHelp: No email address? Ask the school office for a temporary password.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in with it now.
reset.chooseIntro: Choose a password you have not used for this account before.

invite.title: Set up your account
invite.intro: Choose a password for your school account.
invite.done: Your account is ready. Sign in with your email address and the password you chose.
invite.askAdmin: Ask the school office to send you a new invitation.

users.title: Users & roles
users.intro: Staff, students and parents who can sign in, and what each of them may do.
users.empty: No users yet. Add staff first, then students and parents.
users.identifierHint: Use an email address if the person has one. Students without email can have a school username.
users.howToSignIn: How will they sign in the first time?
users.onboardingInviteHint: They get a link to choose their own password (valid for 3 days).
users.onboardingTemporaryHint: You hand it over in person. They must change it at first sign-in.
users.createdNotice: {{name}} was added. Give them the temporary password in person.
users.invitedNotice: {{name}} was added. The invitation email will be sent within a few minutes.
users.invitationPending: The invitation has not been accepted yet.
users.invitationResent: A new invitation will be sent within a few minutes. The old link no longer works.
users.temporaryPasswordHelp: Locked out, or no email? Set a temporary password and hand it over in person.
users.temporaryPasswordWarning: They will be signed out everywhere and must choose a new password at next sign-in.
users.temporaryPasswordSet: Temporary password set. They must change it when they next sign in.
users.disableHelp: Disabling signs them out everywhere and stops them signing in. Their records are kept.
users.disableConfirm: Disable {{name}}? They will be signed out immediately.
users.addIntro: Create an account and choose how the person signs in for the first time.
users.languageHint: Language of their emails and screens.
users.inviteNeedsEmail: Needs an email address. Use a temporary password for usernames.
users.rolesIntro: Roles decide what a person can see and do. You can change them later.
users.emptyHelp: Start with staff accounts, then add students and parents.
users.passwordTemporary: Temporary — must be changed at next sign-in
users.selfSecurityHint: To change your own password, use Your account.

academic.title: Academic setup
academic.intro: Years, terms, grades, subjects, classes, rooms, the bell schedule and the school calendar.
academic.label: Name
academic.name: Name
academic.inUse: In use (untick to retire without deleting)

years.title: Academic years
years.intro: One year is marked current; screens across the system default to it.
years.empty: No academic years yet. Add the current school year to begin.
years.emptyHelp: Add the current school year first; terms, classes and the calendar belong to a year.
years.isCurrentHint: Screens across the system default to the current year.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: Terms must fall inside the year and must not overlap.
terms.empty: No terms in this year yet.
terms.sequenceHint: 1 for the first term, 2 for the second, and so on.
terms.emptyHelp: Add each term with its first and last day.

grades.title: Grades
grades.intro: The grades this school teaches. Choose the subjects each grade takes.
grades.levelHint: Used for ordering: 1 for Grade 1, 13 for Grade 13.
grades.nameHint: As it appears on reports, for example Grade 6
grades.subjectsIntro: Tick the subjects this grade takes. Mark a subject optional if students choose it.
grades.emptyHelp: Add the grades your school teaches, for example Grade 1 to Grade 13.
grades.noSubjectsYet: Add subjects first (Subjects tab), then choose them here.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.intro: Subject names can be given in Sinhala and Tamil as well as English.
subjects.codeHint: Short and unique, for example MATH or SCI
subjects.emptyHelp: Add each subject once; then choose which grades take it.

classes.title: Classes
classes.intro: The class sections of each grade for a year, such as Grade 6 A.
classes.empty: No classes for this year and grade yet.
classes.needYear: Add an academic year first (Years & terms tab).
classes.sectionNameHint: For example A, B or Science
classes.emptyHelp: Create the sections of each grade for this year, such as 6 A and 6 B.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.intro: Classrooms, labs and halls used for classes and the timetable.
rooms.nameHint: For example Room 12 or Science lab

periods.title: Bell schedule
periods.intro: The periods of a school day. Periods must not overlap.
periods.emptyHelp: Add the periods and breaks of a school day in order.
periods.sequenceHint: Position in the day: 1 for the first period.

calendar.title: School calendar
calendar.intro: Holidays, term breaks, exam weeks and events.
calendar.empty: Nothing on the calendar for this year yet.
calendar.isSchoolDay: Classes are held on these days
calendar.yearHint: Leave empty for an event outside the school year.
calendar.emptyHelp: Add holidays, term breaks and exam weeks so everyone plans around them.
calendar.isSchoolDayHint: Untick for holidays and closures; attendance is not expected on those days.

academic.inUseHint: Untick to retire it without deleting history.

rollover.title: Copy classes into {{year}}
rollover.intro: Creates this year's class sections from another year's. Nothing changes until you confirm.
rollover.nothing: That year has no classes to copy.
rollover.note: Subjects are set per grade, so they apply to the new classes automatically. Students are not moved.

settings.title: School settings
settings.intro: How the school's name appears across the system.
settings.name: School name
settings.shortNameHint: Used where space is tight, such as phone screens and printouts.
settings.profileHelp: How the school is named on screens, emails and printouts.
settings.regionalHelp: Defaults for new users and for dates and times.
settings.defaultLanguageHint: New users start in this language; each person can change theirs.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings. Only administrators can change them.

crud.deleteConfirm: Delete this {{noun}}? This cannot be undone.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email/username or password is incorrect.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please slow down.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.csrf: Your session expired. Please reload the page.
errors.setupRequired: This school has not been set up yet.
errors.duplicate: An item with the same name or code already exists.
errors.inUse: This item is still in use and cannot be deleted. Mark it as not in use instead.
errors.invalidReference: A selected item no longer exists. Please refresh and try again.
errors.badRequest: The request could not be processed.
errors.passwordChangeRequired: Please choose a new password before continuing.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Please ask for a new one.
errors.lastAdmin: The school must keep at least one active administrator.
errors.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.useChangePassword: To change your own password, use Change password.
errors.notInvited: This account has already been activated.
errors.userDisabled: This account is disabled. Enable it first.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.studentNotActive: This student is not currently active.
errors.alreadyEnrolled: The student is already in this class.
errors.accountAlreadyLinked: That sign-in account is already linked to another record.
errors.importBadFile: The file could not be read as CSV.
errors.importMissingColumns: The file is missing required columns.
errors.importAlreadyApplied: This file has already been imported.
errors.importFileChanged: The file is different from the one you previewed. Upload it again.
errors.importHasErrors: Fix the rows with errors before importing.
errors.notSchoolDay: The school calendar marks this day as closed.
errors.attendanceLocked: This register can no longer be changed directly. Request a correction instead.
errors.correctionPending: A correction for this student and day is already waiting for a decision.
errors.correctionDecided: This correction has already been decided.
errors.timetableClassBusy: This class already has a lesson in that period.
errors.timetableTeacherBusy: That teacher is teaching another class in that period.
errors.timetableRoomBusy: That room is in use in that period.
errors.timetableTeacherNotAssigned: Assign this teacher to the class and subject first (Staff → Teaching).
errors.announcementPublished: Published announcements cannot be changed or deleted. Withdraw it and publish a new one.
errors.announcementNotLive: This announcement is not currently published.
errors.fileType: This type of file is not accepted. Use PDF, images, Word/Excel/PowerPoint, OpenDocument or plain text.
errors.hasSubmissions: Students have handed in work for this, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.pastDue: The due date has passed and late work is not accepted.
errors.submissionReturned: Your teacher has already returned this work.
errors.reviewState: This version cannot be sent for review or reviewed in its current state.
errors.questionNotApproved: Only approved question versions can be used in a paper.
errors.alreadyFinal: This paper version is already final.
errors.sheetApproved: This mark sheet is approved. Reopen it (with a reason) to change marks.
errors.sheetSubmitted: This mark sheet has been submitted. Ask a moderator to correct it.
errors.reasonRequired: Give a reason for this change.
errors.sheetState: That step is not possible for this mark sheet right now.
errors.marksIncomplete: Enter a mark (or absent/exempt) for every student before submitting.
errors.resultsNotApproved: Every mark sheet for this class must be approved before publishing.
errors.guardianNeedsEmail: Add the guardian's email address first; the invitation is sent there.
errors.guardianNotVerified: Verify at least one of this guardian's links before inviting them.
errors.accountExists: An account with this email or username already exists. Ask an administrator to link it.

common.noAccessHelp: Your role does not include this section. Ask your school administrator if you need it.
common.notFoundHelp: The link may be old or mistyped.
common.offlineBody: Check your internet connection. Nothing has been lost; try again in a moment.

public.tagline: Classes, attendance, exams and results for your whole school, in one place.
public.factData: Your school's data stays in your school's own installation.
public.factLanguages: Works in English, සිංහල and தமிழ்.
public.factDevices: Designed for phones and slow connections.

roleHelp.school_admin: Manages users, roles, school settings and academic setup.
roleHelp.principal: Oversees the school; approves and publishes results.
roleHelp.academic_coordinator: Plans grades and subjects; moderates marks.
roleHelp.teacher: Takes attendance and enters marks for assigned classes.
roleHelp.registrar: Maintains student records and parent links.
roleHelp.student: Sees their own timetable, work and released results.
roleHelp.guardian: Sees their own children's attendance and released results.

table.tryOtherFilters: Try a different search or clear the filters.

placeholder.title: This section is on its way
placeholder.body: It is part of the school's build plan and is not available yet. Everything you see in the menu without a Soon label is ready to use.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Who did what, and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.detailsNote: Only names of fields, roles and ids are recorded — never passwords or the content of changes.

actions.academic_year_rolled_over: Classes copied into a new year

status.title: System status
status.intro: Backups, background jobs and the application, with what to do if something needs attention.
status.backupHelp: Backups are encrypted with the school's passphrase. Copy them off the server regularly.
status.jobsHelp: Emails such as invitations and password resets are sent by the scheduled job every few minutes.
status.emailFile: Not sending — saved on the server for testing

issues.noBackup: No backup has been made yet
issues.noBackupFix: Set a backup passphrase and add the daily backup job in the hosting control panel (see the backup guide).
issues.staleBackupFix: The daily backup job may have stopped. Check the scheduled job and its log in the hosting control panel.
issues.jobsOverdue_one: {{count}} background job is waiting longer than it should
issues.jobsOverdue_other: {{count}} background jobs are waiting longer than they should
issues.jobsOverdueFix: The scheduled job that sends emails is not running. Add or fix it in the hosting control panel.
issues.jobsFailedFix: Usually an email could not be sent. Check the mail server settings, then resend the invitation or reset.
issues.mailOffFix: Set the mail server settings (SMTP) so invitations and password resets reach people.
issues.setupFix: Run the first-time setup to create the school and its administrator.

students.title: Students
students.intro: Every student, their class and status. Open a student to see classes, guardians and history.
students.introScoped: Students currently in the classes you teach.
students.addIntro: Record only what the school needs. You can enrol the student in a class now or later.
students.nameWithInitialsHint: As it should appear on reports and certificates, e.g. A. B. Perera
students.enrolIntoHint: Classes of the selected academic year. Leave empty to enrol later.
students.emptyScoped: No students in your classes yet. Ask the coordinator to assign you to classes.
students.emptyHelp: Add students one at a time or import them from a spreadsheet.
students.privacyNote: Opening a student's profile is recorded in the audit log.
students.noEnrolments: Not enrolled in any class yet.
students.moveHelp: The current class ends the day before the new one starts. Earlier records keep their class.

leave.title: {{name}} is leaving
leave.intro: Ends the current class enrolment. Records and history are kept.
leave.noteHint: Kept with the student's history only; not copied into the audit log.

students.readmitted: Student re-admitted. Enrol them in a class next.

promote.title: Promote a class
promote.intro: Move every student of one class into a class of the next year. Untick students who stay behind.
promote.startsOnHint: Usually the first day of the new year.
promote.untickHelp: Ticked students move. Untick anyone repeating the year.

students.createAccountHelp: The student signs in with this username and must choose a new password the first time.
students.accountCreated: Sign-in created. Give the student their username and temporary password.

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Teaching and non-teaching staff. Link a staff record to a sign-in account to give a teacher their classes.
staff.designationHint: For example Teacher, Sectional head, Clerk
staff.accountHint: The account this person signs in with. One staff record per account.
staff.emptyHelp: Add staff one at a time or import them from a spreadsheet.
staff.teachingNote: Teachers can see students, take attendance and enter marks only for the classes listed here.
staff.subject: Subject

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.intro: Parents and guardians. A guardian sees a student's information only after their link is verified.
guardians.queueHelp: Check each link against the school's records before verifying. Choose how you checked it.
guardians.queueEmptyHelp: New guardian links appear here until someone verifies or rejects them.
guardians.verifyNote: Only verified guardians can see this student's information.
guardians.linked: Guardian linked. Verify the link to give them access.
guardians.findHint: Type at least two letters of a name, phone or email.
guardians.addIntro: Link them to a student from the student's profile.
guardians.inviteHelp: Sends a sign-in invitation to the guardian's email. Only verified links are visible to them.

imports.title: Import data
imports.intro: Bring in students, staff or guardians from a spreadsheet saved as CSV.
imports.newImportHelp: Nothing changes until you review the preview and choose Import.
imports.fileHint: Save the sheet as CSV (UTF-8). Up to 5,000 rows.
imports.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB. Split it into smaller files.

help.students: Rows are matched by admission number, so importing a corrected file updates them. Dates may be YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Grade and class refer to the current academic year.
help.staff: Rows are matched by staff number. Link sign-in accounts afterwards from the Staff page.
help.guardians: Each row links a guardian to a student by admission number. Guardians are matched by phone, then email. New links need verification.

imports.alreadyApplied: This exact file has already been imported.
imports.fixErrors: Fix these rows, then check the file again
imports.fixErrorsHelp: Line numbers match your spreadsheet (line 1 is the header).
imports.applyHelp: Everything is imported together, or nothing is.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.intro: Take the daily register, see attendance over time and handle corrections.
attendance.noClassesHelp: You can take attendance for classes you teach or are class teacher of. Ask the coordinator to assign you.
attendance.closed: The school is closed on this day ({{title}}).
attendance.outsideYear: This date is outside the class's academic year.
attendance.lockedHelp: Registers can be changed only on the day itself. Use Request correction to change a mark; it needs a reason and approval.
attendance.noStudents: No students were in this class on this date.
attendance.reasonHint: Kept with the correction for the approver; not shown in the audit log.
attendance.correctionsHelpApprover: Check each reason before approving. Approved corrections change the register; the history is kept.
attendance.reasonPrivacy: Reasons are visible to approvers and the person who asked, and are never copied into the audit log.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.intro: Your week and the timetables of classes, teachers and rooms.
timetable.introManage: Build each class's week. Clashes for classes, teachers and rooms are refused.
timetable.noPeriodsHelp: Add periods in Academic setup → Periods first.
timetable.nothingMine: No timetable for you this year.
timetable.teacherHint: Only teachers assigned to this class and subject are listed.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.intro: Notices from the school for you, your classes or your children.
announcements.empty: No announcements for you right now.

audienceHelp.school: Everyone who can sign in will see this.
audienceHelp.role: Everyone who has this role will see this.
audienceHelp.grade: Students now in this grade, their verified guardians, and staff who teach the grade.
audienceHelp.class: Students now in this class, their verified guardians, and staff who teach the class.
audienceHelp.guardians_of_class: Only the verified guardians of students now in this class.

announcements.editorHelp: Save a draft to finish later. Once published it cannot be edited, only withdrawn.
announcements.expiresHint: Hidden from feeds after this day.

portal.noClassTeacher: You are not class teacher of any class.
portal.privacy: You only ever see your own records or your verified children's.

learning.title: Learning
learning.intro: Notes, worksheets and assignments from your teachers.
learning.introStaff: Share notes and set assignments for the classes and subjects you teach.
learning.noAssignments: You are not assigned to teach any class this year yet.
learning.allowLateHint: Late work is marked as late.
learning.fileHint: PDF, images, Office or OpenDocument files, plain text. Up to 10 MB each.
learning.fileTooLarge: A file is larger than 10 MB.
learning.resubmitNote: Handing in again replaces your earlier work.
learning.closed: The due date has passed and late work is not accepted.

questions.title: Question bank
questions.intro: Write and review questions, then build exam papers from approved versions.
questions.newHelp: Saved as a draft. Send it for review when ready; only approved versions can go into papers.
questions.emptyHelp: Questions you can write are for subjects you teach.
questions.question: Question
questions.licenceHint: For material from elsewhere, e.g. past papers or CC BY.
questions.outcomeHint: The syllabus outcome this question checks.
questions.editHelp: Saving creates a new version. Earlier versions and papers that use them stay as they are.
questions.finalHelp: This version is final and cannot change. Saving starts a new draft version.
questions.noApproved: No more approved questions for this subject.
questions.addHelp: The approved version at the time of saving is fixed into the paper.
questions.paperFinalized: Paper finalised. This version can no longer change.

exams.title: Exams & results
exams.intro: Enter and check marks, approve them, and publish results as fixed versions.
exams.noSeries: No exams set up for this year.
exams.noSeriesHelp: The academic coordinator sets up exams, papers and grading scales.
exams.noSheets: No mark sheets for you in this exam.
exams.noSheetsHelp: You can enter marks for the classes and subjects you are assigned to teach.
exams.noComponents: This exam has no papers set up yet.

lockedHelp.submitted: Submitted for moderation. Only a moderator can change marks now.
lockedHelp.approved: Approved. Marks are locked; reopening needs a reason.

exams.correctHelp: You are changing submitted marks. Each change is recorded with your reason.
exams.draftKept: Unsaved marks are kept on this device until you save.
exams.previewNote: Preview from current marks. Results can be published once every sheet is approved.
exams.releasesHelp: Each publication is a fixed copy. A correction publishes a new version with a reason; earlier versions stay as they were.
exams.scalesHelp: Changing a scale makes a new version; exams keep the version they were set up with.
exams.bandsHint: One per line: lowest percentage, grade, optional label. Include a band at 0.
exams.componentsHelp: Each grade and subject needs at least one paper. Weights decide how papers combine into the subject mark.

results.intro: Results the school has published. Published results do not change; corrections appear as a new version.
results.noChildren: No linked students yet. The school verifies guardian links before results are shown.
results.none: No results have been published yet.
